details:
Project Details - Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

We developed Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, an interactive space-survival game that simulates the challenges of a real astronaut mission. Players take the roles of astronauts aboard a remote space station, where they must manage oxygen, food, water, and electricity, complete technical tasks, and make decisions that affect the crew’s survival.

Our project addresses the challenge of making STEM education more engaging. Instead of simply reading about space, players learn through simulated situations that develop critical thinking, teamwork, resource management, and problem-solving skills.

We designed the game around realistic spacecraft operations and researched technical materials from NASA and other space organizations to understand life-support systems, spacecraft components, and astronaut activities. Our project is a web-based game, developed using web technologies and prepared for mobile deployment with Capacitor 8. We also used GitHub for project development and version control and Android Studio to test the Android version.

What makes our project creative is the combination of space exploration, survival gameplay, and educational challenges. We also incorporated inspiration from Kazakhstan’s space heritage, particularly the Baikonur Cosmodrome. Our goal is to make space science more accessible and inspire young people to become future engineers, programmers, and explorers.
